e-23, well below the 1e-12 target.

Earlier candidates were polynomial-type approximations that plateaued around 1e-8 to 1e-9. The residual of a polynomial-plus-1/P fit oscillated in P with a period of about 14, which pointed to a slow sine in P. A scan over the sine frequency found it at ω ≈ 0.451.
